ITEM 1 | Round, smooth, glossy object about 9.5 cm across with a red-to-orange skin, yellow-green patches and fine streaks, and a hollow opening at the top showing pale yellow-green interior around a darker center. Firm, holds its shape, sits alone in the center of a white square plate. | 220 g
ITEM 2 | Tiny irregular pale-yellow piece about 1 cm across, matte and slightly granular, lying on the white plate to the upper left of the round object. | 2 g
